dedupe_keys.name: urbanmicroclimatefoam openfoam solver for coupled urban microclimate

description: urbanMicroclimateFoam is an open-source multi-region solver built on OpenFOAM for the coupled physical processes of urban microclimate. An air subdomain is solved with computational fluid dynamics for turbulent convective flow and heat and moisture transport, porous urban building materials are solved with a coupled heat and moisture transport model, and a view-factor radiation model computes net longwave and shortwave fluxes on each surface; the README shows street-canyon surface temperatures and pedestrian-height air temperature and wind in the Münsterhof square in Zürich. Coverage: generic; the user builds the mesh. Access: source on GitHub, tagged for OpenFOAM Foundation versions 6, 7, 8 and 12, with a wiki and tutorial cases. Licence: GPL 3.0. Caveats: requires OpenFOAM and CFD expertise, and city-scale runs are computationally heavy. Simulation uses: pedestrian heat stress in squares and street canyons, evaluating vegetation, water and material cooling measures. Related records: ENVI-met, the Vertical City Weather Generator and the UMEP platform.
